meta.title: Token stats
meta.description: Shows whole-DSH token usage by provider from local DSH session logs (today / this week starting Monday / custom range); keys are optional: with an Ollama key it also shows Ollama Cloud 5-hour session and weekly limits plus official request counts, and with an OpenCode key it shows OpenCode Go rolling 5-hour / weekly / monthly quotas and local opencode CLI token/cost usage; sections for unconfigured providers are hidden.
